what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Haust Network site Go to haust.network to see the product list for the layer 2 network.
2 Step 2 : Read the Wallet entry Find the Wallet entry, which describes a non-custody wallet built on account abstraction and Guardians.
3 Step 3 : Look at the DEX entry Read the DEX entry, which says it operates on the Haust blockchain and lets users trade crypto without an intermediary.
4 Step 4 : Check the roadmap Scroll to the roadmap and the product list to see which items are marked coming later, such as Lending, the DAO and Haustoria.
